title: Toronto ARMY Rallies Ahead of BTS's First Canadian Shows Since 2018
detail: August 20, 2026 — With BTS's two-night Rogers Stadium stand two days out (Aug 22-23) — the group's first Canadian concerts since 2018 — local fan community BTS Army Toronto, run by Sokvin Vann and her son Jordan, describes a citywide buildup ARMY are calling a homecoming. 'It feels like a homecoming, right? From 2018 to the missed 2020 concert. Now eight years later, it feels like our seven kings are coming home,' Vann told reporters. Rogers Stadium is expected to draw roughly 100,000 fans across the two sold-out nights.

media.caption: BTS Army Toronto anticipates the group's first Canadian shows since 2018 at Rogers Stadium.

title: Illinois Governor Declares 'BTS Day' Ahead of Chicago Soldier Field Shows
detail: August 20, 2026 — Illinois Governor JB Pritzker proclaimed August 27-28 'BTS Day' in Illinois, honoring the group's two sold-out Soldier Field concerts — BTS's first Chicago shows in more than seven years. The proclamation, petitioned by the fan group Chicago BTS Army and the HANA Center (an Irving Park immigrant-advocacy nonprofit), states BTS 'has transcended international borders and utilizes their platform to champion social causes, including mental health awareness, self-love, and global philanthropy.' The two groups also launched a 'Borahae Purple' campaign — referencing the ARMY phrase 'I purple you' — to light Chicago's downtown skyline purple; Willis Tower is set to glow purple 8:30-11 p.m. on both concert nights, with fan gatherings planned at Buckingham Fountain and across Chinatown and Downtown.

media.caption: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker cited BTS's global philanthropy in declaring 'BTS Day' ahead of the group's Soldier Field shows.
